Claude mode is the same Mnemo assistant, only smarter: it runs on your Claude subscription, sees your memory, conversations, tasks and people, and can search the web. Claude · code mode changes the app itself: it edits Mnemo\'s code, commits and, when you ask (\"ship it\"), pushes to GitHub; the server and the app then update on their own.
